preparation.scope: Routing obstructions outside macro footprints with same-layer pin corridors; no LEF, cell, connection, power route, clock or constraint changes. Needs fresh GRT, detailed routing and unchanged DRC decks.

check.scope: Coverage of recorded outside marker rectangles by new routing blockages is geometric only, not a DRC verdict; markers and topology refer to the original baseline, not ECO18.

reproduction.interpretation: Repeating preparation with the delivered tool yields the exact same ODB bytes. After adding two invalid-bounds negative controls, all 17 geometry tests pass.

limitations: All 206 outside marker boxes touch signal-route geometry on their reported layers. Proximity does not establish sole causality; standard-cell pin shapes and macro LEF obstructions were excluded from this route census.
178 historical marker boxes lie wholly in the new blockages, 23 partly and five not at all because they coincide with pin corridors. This geometric overlay is not a post-route DRC result.
The added obstructions reserve routing resources, not extra die area. GRT, detailed routing, antenna repair, extraction and unchanged Magic rerun remain necessary.
The 436 original markers inside macro footprints are not addressed by this outside-ring experiment.
The source ODB is ignored build output with its exact digest recorded; this is not a substitute for the absent historical artifacts in review F6.
